subject: Request: 2x Runtime hires for GPU-pool orchestration and capacity
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-02T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Request: 2x Runtime hires for GPU-pool orchestration and capacity

Hi Kim / Marissa,

Quick summary: I’m requesting approval to open two full-time roles focused on enabling the Dedicated GPU-pool roadmaps we committed to for Q1:

  - Senior Runtime Engineer (GPU orchestration, scheduler/kubernetes integration) — comp band: L5/L6, target base $180k-$215k, total comp (est) $220k-$270k with equity/bonus.
  - Runtime Orchestration PM (technical PM to own rollout, SLOs, canary policies) — comp band: P3, target base $150k-$175k, total comp (est) $170k-$200k.

Why now: customer LOIs and Dedicated capacity commitments from two mid-market accounts (Nimbus, Acadia) require a focused engineer and PM to handle kernel scheduling tradeoffs, autoscaling policies, and canary rollout playbooks. Without these hires we expect increasing latencies at T+3 months when we cross concurrent-request thresholds for our current GPU pools.

Attached: JD_runtime_orchestration.docx (draft), and a quick cost workbook I pulled together. High-level ask is +2 headcount for Runtime/Platform, start-of-hire this quarter, onboard by mid-Jan.

Requested approvals:
  1) Headcount: +2 (runtime domain)
  2) Compensation bands above (confirm range and any exceptions)
  3) Budget owner sign-off so Recruiting can start active search and engage TalentBridge (cc’d recruiter contact: Liam).

If you want I can split the hires (one hire + 6mo contractor) but the PM role is time-sensitive for Q1 runbooks.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2x Runtime hires for GPU-pool orchestration and capacity

Diego — thanks for the write-up, this is aligned with what I heard in the infra sync. A few asks before I can greenlight:

  - Can Marcus confirm the incremental quarterly run-rate for both hires (including benefits, bench, ramp)? Please show Q1 and Q2 impact.
  - For the Senior Runtime Engineer, are we expecting a L5 vs L6 hire? Band matters for approval path. If we target L5 we can likely avoid exec escalations.
  - If you propose contractor fallback, include a rough TCO and the ramp time to hit the SLA/capacity deliverables.

Also cc’ing Marissa for hiring plan execution timeline. I’ll tentatively prioritize one slot (engineer) if costs fit the budget.

— Kim
Kimberly Park
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-02T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2x Runtime hires for GPU-pool orchestration and capacity

Kim / Diego — I ran the numbers and put a short table in the attached cost_breakdown_q1_q2.xlsx. TL;DR:

  - Senior Runtime Engineer (L5): fully loaded cost ~ $240k/year (base + payroll tax + benefits + avg eq/bonus amort.)
  - Senior Runtime Engineer (L6): fully loaded cost ~ $285k/year.
  - Runtime Orchestration PM (P3): fully loaded cost ~ $190k/year.

Quarterly cadence (if both hires onboarded Jan 15):
  - Q1 (partial ramp): incremental run-rate ~ $120k (two hires prorated)
  - Q2 (full quarter): incremental run-rate ~ $165k.

We have two possible budget sources: a) headcount budget in Platform (remaining $140k this fiscal year) or b) reallocate one slot from adjacent infra squads (we’d still need compensation top-up for an L6). Reallocating reduces net new spend to near zero this year but reduces capacity in the other squad.

I recommend approving one full-time headcount (Senior Runtime Engineer at L5) and one 6-month contractor for the PM/rollout work — that matches Kim’s tentative approach and keeps FY spend within the available headcount pool.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Finance Partner, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-02T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2x Runtime hires for GPU-pool orchestration and capacity

Thanks — I’m fine with Marcus’s recommendation. Operational ask from Recruiting:

  1) Please confirm final job description (attached draft). I trimmed a few wide-scope bullets to keep L5/L6 expectations clear.
  2) If Diego agrees, we’ll open the L5 Senior Runtime Engineer req this week (Greenhouse GH-5742) and engage the contractor bench for a 6-month Technical Program Manager. Liam (TalentBridge) already has one candidate (resume attached) who matches the PM background; Stratus is also sourcing infra engineers.

Next steps: Kim / Marcus to confirm budget routing (reallocate vs net new). I’ll start the req in Greenhouse and get hiring panel scheduled. If you want faster initial coverage we can onboard a contractor with a 2-week start — they can take point on runbooks and handover to PM when hired.

Attachment: candidate_resume_liam_oconnor.pdf

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@talentbridge.ai>, Anna Rivera <anna@nimbus.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2x Runtime hires for GPU-pool orchestration and capacity

Appreciate the quick turnaround team — I agree with the hybrid approach (1x L5 hire + 6mo contractor PM). Marissa: please open the GH-5742 req against Platform headcount and flag the role as L5 with the trimmed JD. Marcus: please confirm the reallocation path (we prefer reallocate one slot from Edge SRE if it's low impact) so we can mark this as not net-new for FY.

Sergio — looping you for prioritization: this work impacts Dedicated SLOs and customer rollouts for Nimbus; can you confirm any downstream tradeoffs if we reassign the Edge SRE slot?

If I don’t hear objections by EOD tomorrow I’ll ask Recruiting to move forward and let Liam start scheduling initial screens.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
